The '''Southern Seas''' are a maritime region associated with [[Alberion]] in the extracted source material.

The Alberion source says the Southern Seas moderate the continent's climate and contribute to the precipitation that supports its temperate rainforests. The exact sea boundaries, islands, naval routes, and relationship to [[Solara]] remain open for a later map pass.
